verdict.rationale: Docs reference a 'Triage findings' workflow (alerts/notifications/tickets) and Semgrep Assistant's AI post-processing claimed to reduce noise by ~20%, showing some noise-reduction/triage capability, but the pack never documents concrete baseline mechanisms (e.g., baseline-commit diffing, nosemgrep inline ignores, or false-positive marking in the platform) that would let a security engineer suppress existing findings so only new ones alert. Community evidence even complains about persistent false positives, with no counter-evidence that baselining resolves this. Missing for 10: explicit documentation/testing of baseline-commit or ignore/suppression mechanisms, and hands-on confirmation that marking findings as false-positive stops future alerts.
